_readme: Single source of truth for the review carousel. Newest first. Add a review here, then run: python3 tools/reviews/build.py. tags decide which service pages show it first: house, roof, gutter, decks. full=false means the text is cut off and is kept out of schema.

reviews.text: These guys are the absolute best! Not only were they incredibly detailed, timely and professional, but no one else even came close to their pricing. Book them now before everyone starts scoffing them up!

reviews.name: Cyndy Kozik
reviews.label: Sep 2026
reviews.text: Matt did an excellent job of cleaning my gutters and roof. I text him once and he followed up right away. We set a date for the service. Matt arrived on time, he and Alex went right to work. I have already scheduled spring pressure washing of my home.

reviews.name: Andrea Braccio
reviews.label: Sep 2026
reviews.text: Matt was prompt, professional and did an amazing job powerwashing our home. The house looks awesome. Thank you Matt.

reviews.name: Joseph DiLella
reviews.label: Sep 2026
reviews.text: I just bought a house and called like 10 dudes to soft wash my roof on the advice of the inspector. No one called back and it was pretty sucky. Saw Matt’s ad on Instagram and texted over. Immediate response and scheduling. He showed up on time for the appointment and was super efficient. His rates were fantastic and he’s an all-around stand up guy. I asked for a COI prior and he sent immediately without question. My roof was washed and the algae destroyed. Honestly, I’m super pleased to just get everything I asked for. I will use his services in the future and highly recommend him. Thanks for being responsive and professional, Matt.

reviews.name: Ross Sealfon
reviews.label: Aug 2026
reviews.text: Matt did a pressure wash at our house and did a great job. He's friendly, professional and on time. Would highly recommend and we'll definitely use MBD again.

reviews.name: Roy Alling
reviews.label: Jul 2026
reviews.text: Just had MBD pressure washing out to do a roof and house wash and the results are incredible. i didn't realize how much grime and algae had built up until it was gone. They were on time, professional, and clearly took care to protect the landscaping and siding while they worked. The roof looks brand new and the whole exterior of the house is noticeably brighter. Great communication throughout and fair pricing for the quality of work. Highly recommend MBD for pressure washing !

reviews.name: Stephanie Dudding
reviews.label: Jul 2026
reviews.text: I highly recommend MBD pressure washing company! From the first phone call to the completion of the job, they were professional, responsive, and courteous. They arrived on time, worked efficiently, and paid attention to every detail. My house, driveway, sidewalks, and patio look absolutely amazing—everything looks fresh, clean, and almost brand new.
